name: Mizuchi no Miko
source:
There is a boy who prefers a solitary journey, Tsubaki Iori.  A boy who had given up on love, living his life without being deeply connected to anyone, always has been and always will be, for the rest of his life. He truly believed it and came to accept it.

Until that time, when he met "her"―

On a remote island that he happens to visit, Makura-jima. A place that should have no connection to him, yet Iori receives an unexpected hospitality. If anything, he seems to have a connection with the god of the island, Watatsu Mizuchi, and his arrival is said to be a predestined fate. Even though Iori does not believe such a wild story, he heeds the wishes of the islanders, deciding to stay until the Housensai Festival.

While on this island, Iori becomes involved with three people who share with him, a "connection."

An overly familiar, yet mysterious young man―Shidara Asuka.
A girl, despite being filled with gloominess, shows genuine affection only to Iori―Saeshiro Misumi.
And, the signboard girl of a lively guest house and the "Priestess of Mizuchi"―Minato Shizuka.

All of them, like Iori, bear peculiar birthmarks on their bodies.

Waiting for the boy, an incomprehensible sense of [i]déjà vu[/i], "connections" that could not be a coincidence.

Eventually, the boy would realize.

That this encounter is a culmination of the curses and sentiments weave together for a thousand years.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://liar.co.jp/mizuti/index.html#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
有一个喜欢独自旅行的少年，伊织椿。一个放弃爱情的男孩，过着与任何人都没有深刻联系的生活，过去是，将来也将是，在他的余生中。他真心相信并接受了这一点。

直到那个时候，他遇见了“她”——

在他偶然访问的一个偏远岛屿枕岛。一个本应与自己毫无关系的地方，伊织却受到了意想不到的款待。如果说有什么不同的话，那就是他似乎与岛之神水渡渡有某种联系，他的到来据说是命中注定的。尽管伊织不相信如此荒诞的故事，但他还是听取了岛民的意愿，决定留下来直到丰泉祭。

在这个岛上时，伊织与三个与他分享“联系”的人发生了关系。

一个过于熟悉又神秘的年轻人——志田明日香。
一个尽管内心充满忧郁却只对伊织表现出真挚感情的女孩——佐城三澄。
还有，热闹旅馆的招牌女孩、“水地的女祭司”——凑静香。

他们都和伊织一样，身上都有奇特的胎记。

等待着男孩，一种难以理解的感觉[i]似曾相识[/i]，“联系”不可能是巧合。

最终，男孩会意识到。

这次相遇是一千年以来诅咒和情感交织在一起的顶峰。

[翻译和编辑自[url=https://liar.co.jp/mizuti/index.html#story]官方网站[/url]]
